categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures printed circuit boards (PCBs) focusing on high-end products for servers, networking, notebooks, base stations, mobile phones, tablets, and automotive electronics. It operates in electronic components manufacturing, computer and peripheral equipment manufacturing, surface treatment, electronic materials wholesale and retail, international trade, and product design.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, multi-layer boards, thick copper, microvias, sequential lamination, and press-fit connector technologies. It continuously develops new technologies such as high-density wafer test boards, next-generation server materials, multiple net via, metal conductive paste bonding, selective copper reduction, and 800G networking boards. Production involves multi-layer PCB fabrication processes with strict quality control and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global leading server manufacturers, networking equipment makers, and electronic product assemblers across information technology, communications, consumer electronics, automotive, industrial, and medical sectors. The company serves major international markets including Taiwan, China, Americas, and Asia, with over 70% of sales exported to well-known multinational corporations.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span Taiwan (headquarters and manufacturing), multiple plants in China (Suzhou, Changshu), and a new facility in Thailand under trial production. Sales markets include Taiwan, China, Americas, Asia, and other regions, with significant revenue contributions from Taiwan, China, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a PCB manufacturer, sourcing raw materials like substrates, copper foil, films, and chemicals from upstream suppliers and delivering finished PCBs to downstream electronic device manufacturers and assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-layer count, thick copper, and HDI PCB technologies to meet demands from AI servers, cloud computing, and networking. R&D focuses on developing next-generation server materials, high-frequency networking boards, wafer test boards, and press-fit connector technologies. The company invests significantly in innovation to enhance product quality, reduce costs, and expand into AI and edge computing applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of printed circuit boards to global electronic manufacturers. The company does not engage in subscription or licensing but focuses on volume sales of high-value PCB products with a strong export orientation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of Taiwan's leading PCB manufacturers, ranking among the top in server board market share. It competes with other major Taiwanese PCB firms such as Compeq, Unimicron, and Nan Ya PCB, as well as international competitors from Japan, Korea, Europe, and China. It differentiates through advanced technology, strong R&D, and close customer collaboration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$39 billion in the latest fiscal year, reflecting nearly 30% year-over-year growth. Net profit increased by over 59%, with strong improvements in gross margin and return on equity. The company has expanded assets and equity significantly, with ongoing capital expenditures to support capacity growth, including a new plant in Thailand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-precision PCB products tailored for AI servers, cloud computing, and networking applications. It offers advanced manufacturing capabilities, strong R&D innovation, and flexible production across multiple geographic locations to meet diverse customer needs. Its value lies in delivering reliable, high-performance PCBs that support cutting-edge electronic products with rapid delivery and technical collaboration.
